title: 6BR w pool, hot tub, game room
description: A true oasis on a one-third acre lot in the middle of Phoenix, with 6 bedrooms, a pool, hot tub and game room. Incredible access to everything Arizona offers, or stay home and enjoy your own mini resort.
amenities: Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, olympic-sized
review_snippets: Our stay was great & quick communication - awesome pool & game room! There were some ants in the primary bed/bathroom, but Sarah was super-responsive & had spray delivered to the house for us to use!
We loved our stay here! We had a large group and we had so much fun at this awesome air bnb. Definitely would stay here again!

The stay was great, and provided us a tropical retreat while on the trip. Only major issue was that two of the rooms we counted were only separated by a sliding barn door. We did not note that from the pictures, so it forced two families to be more close after the week stay. Really is five bedrooms instead of six.
